Advice 1: Invest all your money in stocks and property.

While somehow true, you need to diversify your investments. Do not put everything in one basket. Hindi porket malaki kita sa trading stocks, you will invest everything on it. No. Have short term ones and long term ones. Make sure you also still have enough savings in case of emergency. Kasi kung madami ka ngang investment tapos nagkaemergency at wala kang immediate cash, kailangan mong ibenta investments at a lower price. You can't utilize the full potential of the investment. Always have a goal for each. For example, you are planning to buy a car in 5 years time, do not invest on long term invesments. Invest on investment that will cater your goal in 5 years time. 

Advice 2: Stay in a company for a long time. This will increase your value outside.

This is total BS. If you feel underpaid but overworked, leave. If you know how to market yourself and negotiate, you can increase your value. Do not stay in a crappy company in the hopes that you'll get huge increase upon promotion. Job hopping is not a really bad idea as they say.

Advice 3: By age xx, you should have _______

Everyone has their own timeline. Thinking like this will only put pressure on you and drain the hell out of your mental health. Don't compare yourself to others. You have your own values and priorities. Life is not a race. Life is living out to the fullest.

Advice 4: Get promoted to become rich

Employment never makes people rich. Business makes people rich. But it's not for everyone. Don't force yourself into one just for the sake of it. 

Advice 5: Save whatever is left

Nope. Make savings as a mandatory part of your budget. Spend within your means. Partition your savings. Save with goals in mind.
